definitions.explanation: shipping payment collected from the recipient upon delivery

examples.japanese: {着払|ちゃくばら}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
⟦{送料|そうりょう}→送料：06128_souryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{着払|ちゃくばら}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Shipping will be collect on delivery.

examples.japanese: {着払|ちゃくばら}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。

notes:
{着払|ちゃくばら}い means the recipient pays the shipping cost when the package arrives (⟦{着|ちゃく}→着：27655_chaku⟧ arrival + ⟦{払|ばら}い→払い：09655_barai⟧ payment).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {着払|ちゃくばら}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to send freight collect
- {着払|ちゃくばら}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不可|ふか}→不可：01922_fuka⟧: collect not accepted

DIFFERENCE FROM {代引|だいび}き:
- {着払|ちゃくばら}い: only the shipping cost is collected on delivery
- ⟦{代引|だいび}き→代引き：09721_daibiki⟧ (⟦{代金引換|だいきんひきかえ}→代金引換：28163_daikinhikikae⟧): the item price AND shipping are both collected on delivery

RELATED WORDS:
- {元払|もとばら}い: prepaid shipping, sender pays
- ⟦{送料|そうりょう}→送料：06128_souryou⟧⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧: shipping included in the price

REGISTER: Neutral; common in shipping and e-commerce.
